result.topic_en: Notes on how the meaning of the word 'hypothesis' has changed since Newton. They quote Newton's 'hypotheses non fingo' passage, Arago's account of Laplace's cosmogony and his remark to Napoleon, and cite Leibniz's letters to Des Bosses; the margins hold differential formulas and small numerical calculations.
